description: This file is a shell script used for testing aspects of git commit behavior, specifically related to editing hunks with 'git commit -p -m'. It sets up test cases, runs git commands with certain environment variables, and checks for expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Runs cleanup commands after a test completes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
